title: React Parity Scope Classification Matrix (machine-readable authority)
authorityNote: Machine-readable authority for the React parity scope classification. The companion docs/architecture/react-parity-scope-classification-matrix.md is the human-review view and must stay consistent with this file. This is a governance tracking artefact, not a rank-1 semantic-corpus artefact, and is enforced by tools/validate-parity/validate-parity.py.

domains.behaviour_summary: Keycloak/OIDC brokering, session cookies, claim/role mapping, credential lifecycle, JWKS/discovery.

make parity (validate-auth USF-AUTH-001..023 with planted defects)
domains.evidence: ADR 0012 (Keycloak sole IdP + local token validation, building on ADR 0010) and the auth-and-identity standard. Implemented hermetically: local Keycloak-issued OIDC/JWT verifier (iss/aud/sig/exp/nbf/alg/kid, fail-closed; rejects non-Keycloak and brokered-upstream issuers), stable actor mapping (realm+subject, never email; duplicate-email no-merge), session lifecycle (expiry/idle/revoke/logout fail-closed, value-free), identity-to-tenant handoff through the PDP (claims/roles/broker alias never grant), cross-tenant SSO with explicit memberships, value-free identity audit, and USF-149 bounded local enterprise identity control plane for tenant SSO lifecycle, requester/approver separation, JIT policy, domain collision fail-closed, invitations, assurance step-up policy, account linking, attribute/group mapping without direct role grants, privileged SSO PDP actions, browser-flow security semantics, and local threat-signal audit posture. Proven by make auth-proof and validate-auth.
